candidates.label: Spiritual blindness cycle: assuming immunity from divine trial leads to loss of perception; repentance accepted then blindness returns for many
candidates.definition: In 5:71: They thought there would be no fitnah so they became blind and deaf. Then Allah turned to them in forgiveness; then many of them became blind and deaf again. And Allah is Seeing of what they do.

evidence.excerpt: وَحَسِبُوٓاْ أَلَّا تَكُونَ فِتۡنَةٞ فَعَمُواْ وَصَمُّواْ ثُمَّ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ عَمُواْ وَصَمُّواْ كَثِيرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wahasiboo alla takoona fitnatun faAAamoo wasammoo: assumption of trial immunity precedes sensory-spiritual loss. Thumma taba Allahu AAalayhim: divine mercy intervenes. Thumma AAamoo wasammoo katheerun minhum: relapse into blindness affects majority. WaAllahu baseerun bima yaAAmaloona: divine observation persists regardless of human perception state.

candidates.urduLabel: دورة العمى الروحي: افتراض المناعة من الفتنة يؤدي لفقدان الإدراك؛ التوبة مقبولة ثم يعود العمى للكثيرين
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes cyclical pattern of spiritual degradation distinct from linear apostasy narratives. Fitnah-immunity assumption identified as root cognitive error. Divine repentance acceptance shows mercy not contingent on permanence of reform. Majority-relapse statistic (katheerun minhum) warns against complacency after forgiveness. Baseer attribute frames divine awareness as constant counterpoint to intermittent human perception.

candidates.label: Messiah's self-testimony: Isa ibn Maryam explicitly commands worship of Allah alone and denies divinity through shared human nature with his mother
candidates.definition: In 5:72: The Messiah said O Children of Israel worship Allah my Lord and your Lord. In 5:75: The Messiah son of Mary was not but a messenger; messengers passed before him. His mother was a siddiqah. They both used to eat food.

evidence.excerpt: لَقَدۡ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُ ٱلنَّارُۖ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارٖ
evidence.rationale: Waqala almaseehu ya banee israeela oAAbudoo Allaha rabbee warabbakum: Messiah's own quoted speech directing worship exclusively to Allah. Rabbee warabbakum establishes shared Creator eliminating ontological distinction.

evidence.excerpt: مَّا ٱلۡمَسِيحُ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٞ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُۥ صِدِّيقَةٞۖ كَانَا يَأۡكُلَانِ ٱلطَّعَامَۗ ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرۡ أَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Ma almaseehu ibnu maryama illa rasoolun: explicit limitation to messenger status. Qad khalat min qablihi alrrusulu: placement within prophetic succession. Waommuhu siddeeqatun: mother's righteousness noted without elevation. Kana yakulani alttaAAama: shared food-consumption as creaturely proof.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Primary Quranic evidence of Isa's self-understanding as servant-messenger

candidates.urduLabel: شهادة المسيح على نفسه: عيسى ابن مريم يأمر صراحة بعبادة الله وحده وينفي الألوهية من خلال طبيعته البشرية المشتركة مع أمه
candidates.notes: Overlap with isa-story. Messiah's own speech as primary evidence prevents attribution of later theological development. Eating-food argument operates at ontological level: divine beings do not consume. Siddiqah designation honors Maryam without implying supernatural status. Dual-address (rabbee warabbakum) collapses any hierarchical distinction between Messiah and community.

candidates.label: Religious excess prohibition: ghuluww (exceeding bounds) in religion forbidden; following desires of previously misguided communities warned against
candidates.definition: In 5:77: Say O People of the Scripture do not exceed limits in your religion beyond the truth and do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before and misled many and have strayed from the soundness of the way.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا تَغۡلُواْ فِي دِينِكُمۡ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَ قَوۡمٖ قَدۡ ضَلُّواْ مِن قَبۡلُ وَأَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرٗا وَضَلُّواْ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
evidence.rationale: La taghloo fee deenikum ghayra alhaqqi: ghuluww defined as exceeding truth-boundaries not merely excessive practice. Wala tattabiAAoo ahwaa qawmin qad dalloo min qablu: historical precedent as warning mechanism. Waadalloo katheeran: misleadership quantified showing scale of damage. Wadalloo AAan sawai alssabeeli: deviation from sound path as endpoint of excess.

candidates.urduLabel: تحريم الغلو في الدين: تجاوز الحدود في الدين محظور؛ التحذير من اتباع أهواء أقوام ضلوا من قبل
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Ghuluww concept applicable beyond Trinity to any religious innovation exceeding textual bounds. Ahwaa (inclinations/desires) identifies psychological driver of excess. Historical-cautionary structure links present behavior to past community failures. Sawaa al-sabeel (sound path) implies balanced middle exists between deficiency and excess. Addressed to People of Scripture but principle universalizes through structural parallel with Muslim community warnings elsewhere.

candidates.label: Communal moral enforcement failure: not forbidding mutual wrongdoing cited as ground for divine curse alongside disobedience and transgression
candidates.definition: In 5:78-79: Cursed were those who disbelieved among Children of Israel by tongue of Dawud and Isa son of Maryam because they disobeyed and transgressed. They used not to prevent one another from wrongdoing they did. How wretched what they were doing.

evidence.excerpt: لُعِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُۥدَ وَعِيسَى ٱبۡنِ مَرۡيَمَۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَواْ وَّكَانُواْ يَعۡتَدُونَ
evidence.rationale: LuAAina allatheena kafaroo min banee israeela AAala lisani dawooda waAAeesa ibni maryama: curse pronounced through prophetic tongues giving it scriptural authority. Thalika bima AAasaw wakanoo yaAAtadoona: dual grounds (disobedience + habitual transgression).

evidence.excerpt: كَانُواْ لَا يَتَنَاهَوۡنَ عَن مُّنكَرٖ فَعَلُوهُۚ لَبِئۡسَ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Kanoo la yatanahawna AAan munkarin faAAaloohu: negative formulation emphasizes active omission. Labisa ma kanoo yafAAaloona: comprehensive condemnation of collective behavior.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Moral enforcement failure as covenant-breach mechanism

candidates.urduLabel: فشل الإنكار المتبادل: عدم النهي عن المنكر سبب للعن الإلهي إلى جانب المعصية والاعتداء
candidates.notes: Overlap with covenants-ahd. Yatanahawna (mutual prevention) implies reciprocal communal obligation not top-down enforcement. Curse-through-prophets structure shows internal scriptural witness against community. Habitual aspect (kanoo) indicates systemic rather than incidental failure. Positioned immediately after Christological section suggesting doctrinal error and moral collapse are interconnected phenomena.

candidates.label: Christian affection proximity: Christians identified as nearest in mawaddah to believers due to presence of priests monks and absence of arrogance
candidates.definition: In 5:82: You will find nearest of them in affection to the believers those who say we are Christians. That is because among them are priests and monks and they are not arrogant.

evidence.excerpt: ۞لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ ٱلنَّاسِ عَدَٰوَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱلۡيَهُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْۖ وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقۡرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا نَصَٰرَىٰۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قِسِّيسِينَ وَرُهۡبَانٗا وَأَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Walatajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatan lillatheena amanoo allatheena qaloo inna nasara: comparative superlative (aqrabahum mawaddatan) establishes graduated affinity scale. Thalika bianna minhum qisseeseena waruhbanan: institutional-religious explanation. Waannahum la yastakbiroona: character-trait explanation (humility) completing causal chain.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Differentiated assessment within People of Book covenant framework

candidates.urduLabel: قرب المودة النصرانية: النصارى أقرب مودة للمؤمنين بسبب وجود القسيسين والرهبان وعدم الاستكبار
candidates.notes: Overlap with people-of-book. Mawaddah (affection/love) stronger term than mere tolerance or peace. Priest-monk presence suggests institutional structures preserving certain virtues. Humility (la yastakbiroona) presented as decisive factor enabling truth-recognition. Does not endorse Christian doctrine but acknowledges positive moral-spiritual qualities. Graduated structure (Jews-mushrikoon vs Christians) prevents monolithic treatment of non-Muslim communities.

candidates.label: Truth recognition through tears: believing Christians' eyes overflow with tears upon hearing revelation due to recognized truth; immediate faith confession and witness-status request
candidates.definition: In 5:83-84: When they hear what was revealed to the Messenger you see their eyes overflowing with tears from what they recognized of the truth. They say our Lord we have believed so register us among the witnesses. Why should we not believe in Allah and what came to us of truth hoping our Lord admits us with the righteous.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا سَمِعُواْ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمۡعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّۖ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
evidence.rationale: Waitha samiAAoo ma onzila ila alrrasooli tara aAAyunahum tafeedu mina alddamAAi: physical-emotional response preceding intellectual articulation. Mimma AAarafoo mina alhaqqi: recognition (not new learning) triggers response. Rabbana amanna faoktubna maAAa alshshahideena: immediate verbal confession with eschatological registration request.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَنَطۡمَعُ أَن يُدۡخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wama lana la numinu biAllahi wama jaana mina alhaqqi: rhetorical question affirming belief inevitability. WanatmaAAu an yudkhilana rabbuna maAAa alqawmi alssaliheena: eschatological hope expressed as aspiration not entitlement.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Christian response to Quranic revelation as continuation of Isa-tradition recognition

candidates.urduLabel: التعرف على الحق بالدموع: عيون المؤمنين النصارى تفيض بالدمع عند سماع الوحي اعترافاً بالحق؛ إيمان فوري وطلب الشهادة
candidates.notes: Overlap with isa-story. Tearful recognition suggests pre-existing scriptural familiarity enabling truth-identification. Shahideen (witnesses) implies bearing testimony to truth across temporal boundaries. Rhetorical question format (5:84) presents belief as rational necessity given evidence. Hope-aspiration (natmaAAu) contrasts with presumption maintaining humble posture. Model of sincere interfaith engagement rooted in shared Abrahamic heritage.

candidates.label: Oath legislation: unintentional oaths (laghw) exempt from liability; binding intentional oaths require graded expiation; guard oaths command linked to gratitude
candidates.definition: In 5:89: Allah will not impose blame for laghw in your oaths but will impose blame for what you bound of oaths. Its expiation is feeding ten needy from average family food or clothing them or freeing a slave. Whoever cannot find then fasting three days. That is expiation for oaths when sworn. Guard your oaths. Thus Allah clarifies signs that you may be grateful.

evidence.excerpt: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغۡوِ فِيٓ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ ٱلۡأَيۡمَٰنَۖ فَكَفَّـٰرَتُهُۥٓ إِطۡعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَٰكِينَ مِنۡ أَوۡسَطِ مَا تُطۡعِمُونَ أَهۡلِيكُمۡ أَوۡ كِسۡوَتُهُمۡ أَوۡ تَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖۖ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَٰثَةِ أَيَّامٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ كَفَّـٰرَةُ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡ إِذَا حَلَفۡتُمۡۚ وَٱحۡفَظُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
evidence.rationale: La yuakhithukumu Allahu biallaghwi fee aymanikum: laghw exemption establishes intentionality principle. Walakin yuakhithukum bima AAaqqadtumu alaymana: aqqadtum (bound/knotted) implies deliberate commitment. Fakaffaratuhu itAAamu AAasharati masakeena: primary expiation feeds community. Aw kiswatuhum aw tahreeru raqabatin: alternative options accommodate varying circumstances. Faman lam yajid fasiyamu thalathati ayyamin: fasting as accessible fallback. Waihfathoo aymanakum: proactive guard command. Kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi laAAallakum tashkuroona: legislative clarity aimed at cultivating gratitude.

candidates.urduLabel: تشريع الأيمان: الأيمان اللغو معفاة من المؤاخذة؛ الأيمان المعقدة المقصودة تتطلب كفارة متدرجة؛ أمر بحفظ الأيمان مرتبط بالشكر
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Laghw-aqqadtum distinction introduces mens rea into oath jurisprudence. Graded expiation hierarchy (feed/clothe/free/fast) accommodates economic capacity differences. Average-family-food standard prevents performative minimalism. Three-day fasting as universal fallback ensures accessibility. Gratitude framing transforms legal compliance into spiritual cultivation. Comprehensive single-verse legislation demonstrating Quranic legal precision.

candidates.label: Satanic quartet: intoxicants gambling stone altars divining arrows declared unified rijs from shaytan's work; avoidance linked to success; shaytan's objectives exposed as animosity and hindering dhikr-salah
candidates.definition: In 5:90-91: O believers indeed intoxicants gambling stone altars divining arrows are defilement from shaytan's work so avoid it that you may succeed. Shaytan only wants to cause between you animosity and hatred through intoxicants and gambling and hinder you from remembrance of Allah and prayer. So will you not desist?

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡخَمۡرُ وَٱلۡمَيۡسِرُ وَٱلۡأَنصَابُ وَٱلۡأَزۡلَٰمُ رِجۡسٞ مِّنۡ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ فَٱجۡتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
evidence.rationale: Innama alkhamru waalmaysiru waalansabu waalazlamu rijsun min AAamali alshshaytani: four items grouped under single predicate (rijs) with unified origin (shaytan's work). Faijtaniboohu: avoidance stronger than mere prohibition. LaAAallakum tuflihoona: success conditional on compliance.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلۡبَغۡضَآءَ فِي ٱلۡخَمۡرِ وَٱلۡمَيۡسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ
evidence.rationale: Innama yureedu alshshaytanu an yooqiAAa baynakumu alAAadawata waalbaghdaa: dual social harm (animosity + hatred). Fee alkhamri waalmaysiri: intoxicants-gambling as specific instruments. Wayasuddakum AAan thikri Allahi waAAani alssalati: dual spiritual harm (dhikr + salah obstruction). Fahal antum muntahoona: rhetorical challenge demanding response.

candidates.urduLabel: الرباعية الشيطانية: الخمر والميسر والأنصاب والأزلام رجس من عمل الشيطان؛ الاجتناب مرتبط بالفلاح؛ أهداف الشيطان مكشوفة كإيقاع العداوة وصرف الذكر والصلاة
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Four-item grouping reveals underlying unity: all involve altered states or chance replacing divine reliance. Rijs (defilement) frames issue as purity-pollution not merely harm-benefit. Ijtinab (avoidance) implies complete distance not moderated use. Falah (success) links abstinence to positive flourishing not mere sin-avoidance. Shaytan's strategy analysis exposes mechanisms enabling informed resistance. Rhetorical question (hal antum muntahoona) demands active decision not passive reception.

candidates.label: Ihram hunting test: Allah tests believers with accessible game during sacred state to distinguish unseen taqwa; intentional violation requires judicial compensation; past violations pardoned repeat offenses punished
candidates.definition: In 5:94-95: O believers Allah will test you with something of game your hands and spears reach that Allah may know who fears Him unseen. Whoever transgresses after that has painful punishment. Do not kill game while in ihram. Whoever kills intentionally compensation is equivalent domestic animal judged by two just men among you as offering reaching Kaaba or expiation feeding needy or fasting equivalent to taste consequence. Allah pardoned what is past; whoever returns Allah takes retribution. Allah Exalted Owner of Retribution.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَيَبۡلُوَنَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنَ ٱلصَّيۡدِ تَنَالُهُۥٓ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَرِمَاحُكُمۡ لِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَخَافُهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ فَمَنِ ٱعۡتَدَىٰ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Layabluwannakumu Allahu bishayin mina alssaydi tanaluhu aydeekum warimahukum: test involves physically accessible temptation. LiyaAAlama Allahu man yakhafuhu bialghaybi: purpose is revealing unseen taqwa. Famani iAAtada baAAda thalika falahu AAathabun aleemun: post-legislation transgression carries enhanced penalty.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَقۡتُلُواْ ٱلصَّيۡدَ وَأَنتُمۡ حُرُمٞۚ وَمَن قَتَلَهُۥ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدٗا فَجَزَآءٞ مِّثۡلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ ٱلنَّعَمِ يَحۡكُمُ بِهِۦ ذَوَا عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ هَدۡيَۢا بَٰلِغَ ٱلۡكَعۡبَةِ أَوۡ كَفَّـٰرَةٞ طَعَامُ مَسَٰكِينَ أَوۡ عَدۡلُ ذَٰلِكَ صِيَامٗا لِّيَذُوقَ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهِۦۗ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا سَلَفَۚ وَمَنۡ عَادَ فَيَنتَقِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۡهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
evidence.rationale: La taqtuloo alssayda waantum hurumun: explicit prohibition tied to sacred state. Waman qatalahu minkum mutaAAammidan: intentionality requirement (mutaAAammidan). Fajazaon mithlu ma qatala mina alnnaAAami: equivalence principle. Yahkumu bihi thawa AAadlin minkum: judicial oversight by two just persons. Hadyan baligha alkaAAbati: offering must reach Kaaba ensuring ritual completion. Aw kaffaratun taAAamu masakeena aw AAadlu thalika siyaman: alternative expiations maintaining proportionality. Liyathooqa wabala amrihi: consequence-experiencing as pedagogical purpose. AAafa Allahu AAamma salafa: past pardon. Waman AAada fayantaqimu Allahu minhu: escalation for recidivism. WaAllahu AAazeezun thoo intiqamin: divine retribution capacity affirmed.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Hunting test as explicit divine trial revealing unseen taqwa

candidates.urduLabel: ابتلاء الصيد في الإحرام: الله يختبر المؤمنين بصيد متاح في الحالة المقدسة لتمييز التقوى بالغيب؛ الانتهاك العمد يتطلب تعويضاً قضائياً؛ ما سلف عفي عنه والعائد يعاقب
candidates.notes: Overlap with hajj-umrah-pilgrimage. Test-framing transforms prohibition from arbitrary restriction to spiritual diagnostic. Bialghaybi (unseen) specifies that true taqwa operates beyond surveillance. Judicial oversight (thawa AAadlin) prevents subjective self-assessment. Equivalence principle (mithlu) maintains proportional justice. Triple expiation options accommodate varying capacities. Past-pardon prevents despair; return-warning prevents presumption. Azeezun Thoo Intiqam pairing balances power with justice.

candidates.label: Past consumption pardon: believers who consumed prohibited items before legislation not blamed if they now maintain taqwa faith and righteous deeds in progressive cycles
candidates.definition: In 5:93: There is no blame on those who believed and did righteous deeds concerning what they tasted if they feared Allah and believed and did righteous deeds then feared Allah and believed then feared Allah and did good. And Allah loves the doers of good.

evidence.excerpt: لَيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ جُنَاحٞ فِيمَا طَعِمُوٓاْ إِذَا مَا ٱتَّقَواْ وَّءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّأَحۡسَنُواْۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Laysa AAala allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati junahun feema taAAimoo: blanket exoneration for past consumption. Itha ma ittaqaw waamanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati: first condition set (taqwa + faith + action). Thumma ittaqaw waamanoo: second repetition emphasizing persistence. Thumma ittaqaw waahsanoo: third iteration culminating in ihsan (excellence). WaAllahu yuhibbu almuhsineena: divine love as ultimate reward for sustained excellence.

candidates.urduLabel: العفو عن الطعم السابق: المؤمنون الذين تناولوا المحرمات قبل التشريع لا يؤاخَذون إذا حافظوا على التقوى والإيمان والعمل الصالح في دورات تصاعدية
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Addresses transitional community members who consumed khamr etc. before prohibition. Triple-condition structure suggests progressive spiritual maturation not static compliance. Taqwa-iman-amal triad repeated with variation (final iteration substitutes ihsan for amal) indicating qualitative growth. Junah (blame/sin) negation provides psychological relief preventing retroactive guilt. Muhsinin designation elevates sustained practitioners beyond mere compliance. Positioned after intoxicant prohibition providing immediate pastoral application.
